title: Text to speech, any described voice (AuK)
description: Speaks the text in a voice you describe (or one of the OpenAI-named presets) and returns an MP3. Text longer than ~20 s of speech is spoken sentence by sentence. Roughly 3-4 s of compute per second of speech.

params.name: voice
params.description: Preset voice (OpenAI voice names): alloy: A neutral, balanced adult voice, clear and even, speaking at a natural pace.; ash: A man in his thirties with a warm, slightly raspy voice, relaxed and conversational.; ballad: A man with a soft, melodic voice, gentle and expressive, speaking unhurriedly.; coral: A woman with a warm, friendly voice, upbeat and approachable.; echo: A man with a calm, resonant voice, steady and reassuring.; fable: A British male storyteller with an expressive, animated voice.; nova: A young woman with a bright, energetic voice, lively and clear.; onyx: A man with a deep, authoritative voice, speaking slowly and deliberately.; sage: A woman with a calm, measured voice, thoughtful and wise.; shimmer: A woman with a soft, gentle voice, quiet and soothing.; verse: A man with a versatile, dynamic voice, expressive and engaging.

map.alloy: A neutral, balanced adult voice, clear and even, speaking at a natural pace.
map.ash: A man in his thirties with a warm, slightly raspy voice, relaxed and conversational.
map.ballad: A man with a soft, melodic voice, gentle and expressive, speaking unhurriedly.
map.coral: A woman with a warm, friendly voice, upbeat and approachable.
map.echo: A man with a calm, resonant voice, steady and reassuring.
map.fable: A British male storyteller with an expressive, animated voice.
map.nova: A young woman with a bright, energetic voice, lively and clear.
map.onyx: A man with a deep, authoritative voice, speaking slowly and deliberately.
map.sage: A woman with a calm, measured voice, thoughtful and wise.
map.shimmer: A woman with a soft, gentle voice, quiet and soothing.
map.verse: A man with a versatile, dynamic voice, expressive and engaging.

params.name: instructions
params.description: Optional voice and delivery description that replaces the preset, e.g. 'An elderly man, hoarse and amused, speaking slowly.'

params.name: seconds
params.description: Length in seconds; 0 estimates it from the text. Only used when the text fits one run (~20 s).

params.name: seed
params.description: Same seed and params give the same result. Random when omitted.

params.name: steps
params.description: Sampling steps; fewer is faster, 32 is the reference.

inputs.voice_description: A neutral, balanced adult voice, clear and even, speaking at a natural pace.
